description: park-drinking-fountain-tap-locations is a dataset listed in Peclet Data Portal open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. List of public drinking fountain taps in Brisbane City Council parks. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. Its keywords are assets. The portal shows 2,020 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-peclet-com-au-portal.
